text: អាចទិញសំបុត្រនៅឯណា
literal: where can one buy a ticket — the Angkor pass is sold by Angkor Enterprise at its ticket office or online, not at the temples
provenance: Angkor Enterprise ticket wording (សំបុត្រចូលទស្សនាតំបន់អង្គរ); Smyth, Colloquial Cambodian (Routledge);ipa=km-analysis

text: ត្រូវកក់ទុកជាមុនឬទេ
ipa: trəw kɑk tuk tɕiə mun rɨː teː
literal: must one book in advance — the three-day and seven-day Angkor passes carry the holder's photograph, so they are issued in person
provenance: Angkor Enterprise ticket wording (សំបុត្រចូលទស្សនាតំបន់អង្គរ); Smyth, Colloquial Cambodian (Routledge);ipa=km-analysis

text: អាចចូលបានចុងក្រោយម៉ោងប៉ុន្មាន
ipa: ʔaːtɕ tɕoːl baːn tɕoŋkraoj moːŋ ponmaːn
literal: at what hour can one last enter — at the Angkor checkpoint the dress code is enforced: shoulders and knees covered
provenance: Angkor Enterprise ticket wording (សំបុត្រចូលទស្សនាតំបន់អង្គរ); APSARA National Authority visitor conduct rules for the Angkor park (សម្លៀកបំពាក់សមរម្យ);ipa=km-analysis

text: មានទូដាក់អីវ៉ាន់ឬទេ
ipa: miən tuː dak ʔəjwan rɨː teː
literal: is there a cupboard for putting luggage — the Angkor temples have none, so bags stay with you or in the vehicle
provenance: Headley et al., Cambodian-English Dictionary (Catholic University of America Press, 1977); APSARA National Authority visitor conduct rules for the Angkor park (សម្លៀកបំពាក់សមរម្យ);fix=Headley et al., Cambodian-English Dictionary (1977, and the 1997 edition), and Chuon Nath, Vacananukram Khmer (1967), read on SEAlang (sealang.net/khmer): Chuon Nath's headword is អីវ៉ាន់ (វត្ថុឬរបស់ ... នេះជាអីវ៉ាន់របស់ខ្ញុំ) and Headley 1997 refers ឥវ៉ាន់ to អីវ៉ាន់ (ʔəyvan, objects, goods, baggage);rule=one spelling by the Chuon Nath dictionary, as air-travel.my-luggage-did-not-arrive;row-corrections-v9;ipa=km-analysis

text: ថតរូបបានឬទេ
provenance: Headley et al., Cambodian-English Dictionary (Catholic University of America Press, 1977); Smyth, Colloquial Cambodian (Routledge);ipa=km-analysis

text: សូមថតរូបយើងមួយសន្លឹក
ipa: soːm tʰɑt ruːp jəːŋ muəj sɑnlɨk
literal: please take one photograph of us — សន្លឹក is the classifier Khmer counts photographs with
provenance: Headley et al., Cambodian-English Dictionary (Catholic University of America Press, 1977); Huffman, Modern Spoken Cambodian (Yale, 1970);ipa=km-analysis

text: អាចជួយថតរូបយើងបានឬទេ
ipa: ʔaːtɕ tɕuəj tʰɑt ruːp jəːŋ baːn rɨː teː
literal: can [one] help take a photo of us — the frame carries no second-person pronoun
provenance: Headley et al., Cambodian-English Dictionary (Catholic University of America Press, 1977); Smyth, Colloquial Cambodian (Routledge);ipa=km-analysis
